skills.name: Fatal Fondness
skills.description: Hera targets the enemy who has dealt the most DMG, inflicting Obsession (unable to attack, reduced Movement SPD, and moves toward Hera) for 3s. The target takes DMG equal to 100% of Hera's ATK per second, and Hera restores HP equal to the DMG dealt.

upgrades.level2: Increases per-second DMG to 120% of ATK.
upgrades.level4: Increases per-second DMG to 150% of ATK.

skills.name: Sovereign Domain
skills.description: At the start of battle, Hera creates a Domain of Power on the allied side of the field. While in the domain, Hera gains 2.5% Energy Regen and 5% DMG RED every 5s, stacking up to 6 times. When an enemy enters the domain for the first time, they are suppressed for 2s.

upgrades.level2: Every 5s, Hera additionally gains 7% DMG Reduction.
upgrades.level3: Enemies entering the domain for the first time are suppressed for 3s.
upgrades.level4: When Hera takes fatal DMG, she retracts the Sovereign Domain, becomes immune to DMG for 2.5s, and restores 30% of max HP.

skills.name: Crown's Bestowal
skills.description: Hera grants her crown to the ally with the highest ATK, increasing their ATK by 30% and ATK SPD by 100% for 3s.

skills.name: Powerlust Tide
skills.description: Hera unleashes a Charm Wave at the farthest enemy in a rectangular AoE in front of her, charming them to attack their own allies. The Normal Attack DMG of enemies hit is increased by 40% for 3s.

upgrades.level2: Increases Normal Attack DMG bonus to 60%.
upgrades.level4: Increases Normal Attack DMG bonus to 80%.

relic.name: Phantom Brand
relic.description: Enemies that have been controlled by Hera's Charm and Obsession effects have their Control RES and Effect RES reduced by 30%.

upgrades.level2: Enemies charmed by Hera additionally receive one instance of Crown's Bestowal.
upgrades.level3: Enemies affected by Charm cannot restore Energy during the effect duration.
upgrades.level4: If a charmed enemy is killed during the effect duration, the Charm duration is extended by 5s.
